profile.headline: Software Developer Engineer - AWS at Amazon
profile.summary:
My background consists of developing software for law enforcement agencies and recently has involved creating a unified platform for managing GPS, RF and breath alcohol devices. I enjoy working with new technologies and take great pride in my ability to quickly adapt to different development requirements. 
• Experienced in Javascript, HTML, and CSS languages and being able to apply these
skills in creating front end, user interfaces.
• Advanced understanding for TSQL and SQL languages and working with relational
databases.
• Excellent problem solving skills and an ability to design algorithms for various situations.
• Hands-on experience in developing and shipping software with object oriented languages,
including JAVA and C#.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Built the inventory management sub-system for syncing in-use agency devices to what is currently available in their local inventory.
• Built the user-facing UI and supporting back-end applications giving agencies the ability to customize how the various alerts generated by enrolled devices will be received, allowing them the flexibility to adapt current workflows to all events generated by Sentinel’s platforms.
• Built a Web API allowing 3rd party agencies to utilize Sentinel’s proprietary monitoring platform, allowing them the ability to create, edit and delete clients, while seamlessly integrating the management of their inventory of devices.
• Built and designed a custom monitoring application allowing Sentinel’s 24/7 in house staff to monitor all the currently running proprietary applications, giving them the ability to respond to and mitigate potential system downtime and maintenance issues.
• Led the development of the user-facing UI, for creating the inclusion and exclusion zones for each GPS equipped client.
• Directed the development of the proprietary software “Sentrak" DNA platform, which unified GPS, RF and Alcohol monitoring functions.
• Rebuilt the entire back-end GPS parser that processes the individual points sent by thousands of GPS devices, generating the various inclusion and exclusion zone alerts. 
• Rebuilt the event driven parser for generating offender alerts based on agency configured options.  
• Seamlessly integrated 3rd party APIs into the in-house Sentrak Platform, allowing the use of multiple 3rd party GPS devices to communicate successfully with Sentinel’s applications.
• Re-wrote several applications and their corresponding user-facing UIs adding additional functionality, to significantly increase the expected end-of life of Sentinel’s Alcohol Monitoring devices.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Directed the development of the company’s primary 'Genesis' system used to manage alcohol screening devices
• Rebuilt the front-end code in Windows-Forms for configuring and managing agency alcohol screening devices
• Contributed to the data synchronization project for case management with the courts in Scottsdale, Arizona.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Responsible for teaching weekly group tutoring sessions for up to 10 students from 3 different districts
• Developed weekly pre-algebra and algebra lesson plans for students ranging from elementary to high school
• Provided test prep materials and a specific curriculum unique to each student in order to cater to individual needs
